name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A skill that stops your AI coding assistant from over-building, so it writes about half as much code while keeping all the safety checks.
buyer: Startup engineering leads who pay per token for AI coding and watch agents bloat the codebase with unnecessary wrappers and dependencies.
business_use_cases: A team cuts its AI coding bill by roughly a fifth because the agent writes less code per task.
A solo founder ships features the agent keeps small and reviewable, instead of drowning in generated boilerplate.
An agency delivers cleaner client codebases that are cheaper to maintain later.

money_ideas.idea: A team dashboard that measures 'code bloat avoided' and token savings across an org, sold per seat.
A paid 'clean AI code' consulting package for teams whose agent output has become unmaintainable.

steal_this: Build a tiny report tool that runs on a repo's AI-generated pull requests and shows a manager the lines and dollars saved. Managers pay for proof of savings.
